$note: Hooks WorkOS no longer ships. InstallHooks removes any settings.json registration whose command runs one of these files, so an updated install stops running them; OverlaySystem moves an untouched copy of the file to the backup (an edited one stays on disk) and Doctor ignores what is left. An entry with `events` retires only the registrations on those events; the file still ships and stays registered elsewhere. Never list a hook that hooks.json still registers on a listed event.
